---
title: "Exploration"
---

Use the dropdown menus below to select a president and choose which rating trend(s) to view. Click **▶ Play Trend** to animate public approval, congressional approval, and party favorability trends over time.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(htmltools)

# Load monthly approval and favorability datasets
monthly_data <- read_csv("data/presidential_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = fct_reorder(president, year_month, .fun = min))

congress_data <- read_csv("data/congressional_approval_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = factor(president, levels = levels(monthly_data$president)))

party_data <- read_csv("data/party_favorability_by_month.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(president = factor(president, levels = levels(monthly_data$president)))

presidents <- levels(monthly_data$president)

make_anim_plot <- function(pres) {
  m <- monthly_data |> filter(president == pres) |> arrange(year_month) |> select(year_month, rating = approval) |> mutate(series = "Public Approval")
  c <- congress_data |> filter(president == pres) |> arrange(year_month) |> select(year_month, rating = approval) |> mutate(series = "Congressional Approval")
  p_sub <- party_data |> filter(president == pres) |> arrange(year_month) |> select(year_month, rating = favorability) |> mutate(series = "Party Favorability")

  party_is_dem <- (monthly_data |> filter(president == pres) |> pull(party))[1] == "Democrat"
  pres_col <- if (party_is_dem) "#2E74C0" else "#CB454A"

  colors_map <- c(
    "Public Approval" = pres_col,
    "Congressional Approval" = "#7B2CBF",
    "Party Favorability" = "#2E7D32"
  )

  dates <- unique(m$year_month)

  avail_series <- list(
    "Public Approval" = m,
    "Congressional Approval" = c,
    "Party Favorability" = p_sub
  ) |> keep(\(df) nrow(df) > 0)

  levels_order <- c("Public Approval", "Congressional Approval", "Party Favorability")
  levels_present <- intersect(levels_order, names(avail_series))

  cum_data <- map_dfr(dates, function(d) {
    map_dfr(levels_present, function(sname) {
      sub <- avail_series[[sname]] |> filter(year_month <= d)
      if (nrow(sub) == 0) {
        tibble(year_month = d, rating = NA_real_, series = sname)
      } else {
        sub
      }
    }) |> mutate(frame = as.character(d))
  })

  cum_data$series <- factor(cum_data$series, levels = levels_present)

  fig <- plot_ly(
    cum_data,
    x = ~year_month,
    y = ~rating,
    color = ~series,
    colors = colors_map,
    frame = ~frame,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines+markers",
    connectgaps = TRUE
  ) |>
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste("Ratings During Administration of", pres),
        x = 0.5,
        xanchor = "center",
        y = 0.98,
        yanchor = "top"
      ),
      margin = list(t = 70, b = 60),
      xaxis = list(title = "Date", range = c(min(dates), max(dates))),
      yaxis = list(title = "Rating (%)", range = c(0, 100)),
      shapes = list(
        list(
          type = "line",
          y0 = 50,
          y1 = 50,
          x0 = 0,
          x1 = 1,
          xref = "paper",
          line = list(color = "grey60", dash = "dash", width = 1)
        )
      ),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.05, y = -0.3)
    ) |>
    animation_opts(frame = 80, transition = 40, easing = "linear") |>
    animation_button(x = 0, y = -0.15, label = "▶ Play Trend") |>
    animation_slider(currentvalue = list(prefix = "Date: ")) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

  fig
}

plots <- lapply(presidents, make_anim_plot)

tagList(
  tags$div(
    style = "display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 20px; margin-bottom: 25px;",
    tags$div(
      style = "min-width: 260px; max-width: 320px;",
      tags$label(`for` = "presSelect", style = "font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;", "Select President:"),
      tags$select(
        id = "presSelect",
        class = "form-select",
        onchange = "switchPresident(this.value)",
        lapply(seq_along(presidents), \(i) {
          tags$option(value = paste0("pres-plot-", i), presidents[i])
        })
      )
    ),
    tags$div(
      style = "min-width: 260px; max-width: 320px;",
      tags$label(`for` = "metricSelect", style = "font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 6px; display: block;", "Select Trend to Play:"),
      tags$select(
        id = "metricSelect",
        class = "form-select",
        onchange = "filterMetric(this.value)",
        tags$option(value = "all", "All Ratings (Public, Congress, Party)"),
        tags$option(value = "public", "Public Approval"),
        tags$option(value = "congress", "Congressional Approval"),
        tags$option(value = "party", "Party Favorability")
      )
    )
  ),
  lapply(seq_along(presidents), \(i) {
    tags$div(
      id = paste0("pres-plot-", i),
      class = "president-plot-container",
      style = if (i == 1) "display: block;" else "display: none;",
      plots[[i]]
    )
  }),
  tags$script(HTML("
    let currentContainerId = 'pres-plot-1';

    function switchPresident(val) {
      currentContainerId = val;
      document.querySelectorAll('.president-plot-container').forEach(el => el.style.display = 'none');
      const target = document.getElementById(val);
      if (target) {
        target.style.display = 'block';
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event('resize'));
        applyCurrentMetricFilter();
      }
    }

    function filterMetric(metricVal) {
      applyCurrentMetricFilter();
    }

    function applyCurrentMetricFilter() {
      const metricSelect = document.getElementById('metricSelect');
      if (!metricSelect) return;
      const metricVal = metricSelect.value;
      const container = document.getElementById(currentContainerId);
      if (!container) return;
      const plotEl = container.querySelector('.js-plotly-plot');
      if (!plotEl || !plotEl.data) return;

      const update = { visible: [] };
      plotEl.data.forEach(trace => {
        const name = (trace.name || '').toLowerCase();
        if (metricVal === 'all') {
          update.visible.push(true);
        } else if (name.includes(metricVal)) {
          update.visible.push(true);
        } else {
          update.visible.push('legendonly');
        }
      });

      if (window.Plotly && update.visible.length > 0) {
        Plotly.restyle(plotEl, update);
      }
    }
  "))
)
```
